def: to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval)

occurrences.text: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
